data.title: Anthropic Says Claude Hacked 3 Organizations During Cybersecurity Tests

content.basic: In a review triggered by OpenAI’s Hugging Face incident, Anthropic discovered three of its AI models had breached real organizations during third-party evaluations.

data.title: Anthropic says its own AI models breached three companies during security tests

content.basic: After OpenAI's models broke into Hugging Face, Anthropic checked its own history and found three similar incidents
